nodes.name: api
nodes.summary: Go HTTP API server (Nx project @gardbase/api, own Go module) exposing tenant/object/encryption endpoints over DynamoDB and S3 and proxying crypto ops to the enclave via vsock; built and pushed to ECR with Dockerfile.Api.

nodes.name: enclave-service
nodes.summary: Go service (Nx project @gardbase/enclave-service, own Go module) running inside an AWS Nitro Enclave: attestation, session key derivation and KMS DEK unwrapping over a vsock server; built and pushed to ECR with Dockerfile.enclave.

nodes.name: landing
nodes.summary: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind marketing site (Nx/pnpm project @gardbase/landing) built to dist/apps/landing.

nodes.name: infrastructure-bootstrap
nodes.summary: Terraform workspace (S3 backend key bootstrap/terraform.tfstate, eu-central-1) creating the Lambda code bucket and the ECR repository consumed by the main stack.

nodes.name: infrastructure-main
nodes.summary: Main Terraform workspace (S3 backend key main/terraform.tfstate) provisioning EC2 Nitro hosts, DynamoDB, S3, KMS and CloudWatch; reads the bootstrap remote state and ships dev/prod tfvars.

nodes.name: crypto-sdk
nodes.summary: Standalone Go module github.com/qodesrl/gardbase/pkg/crypto implementing client-side deterministic/probabilistic/order-preserving encryption, KMS helpers and enclave attestation verification; consumed as an SDK, not deployed.

branches.name: main
branches.reason: Default branch (origin/HEAD -> origin/main); receives promotion merges from test.

branches.name: development
branches.reason: Long-lived integration branch in the development -> test -> main promotion flow.

branches.name: test
branches.reason: Long-lived staging branch merged from development and promoted into main via PRs.

branches.name: infrar-test
branches.reason: Tooling branch forked from main with a single 'infrar: import analysis' commit; outside the development/test/main flow.
